design_detail: transitory, temporary tax on large patrimonies earmarked for the justice sector; no rate or threshold
quote_original: Me atreví a hablar de un impuesto a grandes patrimonios, destinado específicamente al sector justicia
quote_en: I dared to speak of a tax on large patrimonies, aimed specifically at the justice sector
source_title: Iván Velásquez: Urgen recursos para justicia
grading_note: His own words, repeating a proposal first made at an ICEFI forum on 10 Nov 2015 (La Hora, same week: 'impuesto transitorio y temporal sobre los grandes patrimonios'). He framed it as an idea for debate; no rate or threshold, so B. Temporary levy on net holdings, typed one_off_levy.

design_detail: backs the extraordinary tax on large fortunes proposed by the CICIG head
quote_original: la única salida es que aquellos que más recursos tienen paguen más
quote_en: the only way out is for those with the most resources to pay more
source_title: El impuesto para seguridad y justicia
grading_note: Column defending the extraordinary tax that, in his account, 'debería aplicarse a las grandes fortunas'. The quoted sentence is his own and general; the wealth target comes from the surrounding text, so C.

design_detail: progressive 2.5% to 5% on net wealth above US$5 million (Central America)
quote_original: Un impuesto progresivo entre 2.5% y 5% a fortunas mayores a los US$5 millones
quote_en: A progressive tax of between 2.5% and 5% on fortunes above US$5 million
source_title: Desigualdades y Fiscalidad en Centroamérica: Resumen ejecutivo
grading_note: Oxfam's Central America programme report 'Más Recursos para más Derechos', launched 25 March 2025; the press note quotes Oxfam's Guatemala director Ricardo Sáenz de Tejada. The proposal covers the region, Guatemala included (the report counts Guatemala's tax loss at 8.1% of GDP). A for the specified design.
